clips.title: The story
paras: At Deathknell's gate, Calvin Montague preys on newly awakened Forsaken leaving the graveyard, tricking passersby into errands for him.

Calvin Montague waits just beyond Deathknell's gates, where the road leads out into Tirisfal Glades. He tries to talk wandering adventurers into carrying his letters, using false pretenses instead of handling his own correspondence or paying a fair courier's fee. Other prominent undead named Montague manage banking interests in the Undercity. Calvin follows a less reputable path, relying on petty schemes and deception.
